OK so 1.0 Enfield gacha in summary for me
So firstly, ignoring everything else, the devs did not get the starter team options right on launch and it took them a week to fix it

However from week two onwards, every single F2P player had access to a team of Endmin/Chen/Ardelia and either Pog or Lifeng, without spending anything at all. Those two teams are completely capable of clearing absolutely all content in the game at maximum difficulty. The entire factory game mode has no monetization. The only limit on that team is that it is locked until you log in for your third day.

So: Endfield has an _unarguably_ completely optional gacha system as of 1.0. It is even more F2P friendly than Morimens. The downside is just that if you factor out the gacha, you're really, really hoping that you like the factory element. If you don't, there are going to be games with better 1.0 stories and better combat. That's really the fact of the matter.
Endfield's 1.0 story is not CZN-levels of bad, but it's well below Morimens c1-5, which IIRC was 1.0 content here

Me: I want one copy of each character, because they're the bulk of the content that is dropped each patch. I don't care about dupes or weapons for characters, because they're just numbers in a spreadsheet

Endfield:
1. dupes are extremely medocre <:EndminYes:1319511272856883210> 
2. weapons are grabbed via a pity currency you build by consistently playing each day and pulling for characters over several patches - they have a unique model, but are otherwise just numbers in a spreadsheet <:EndminYes:1319511272856883210> 
3. each character always has 10 accessible limited pulls for free <:EndminYes:1319511272856883210> 
4. each character always has 10 discounted pulls in a bundle <:EndminYes:1319511272856883210> 
5. each character always has 10 pulls as a rebate if you pulled to 60 on the last character <:EndminYes:1319511272856883210>
6. The worst situation ever is being forced to pull to 120, when standard in 3d gacha is a punishing run to the next pity guarantee (usually 160 or 180) <:EndminYes:1319511272856883210>
7. The game also sneaks in a less-good signature weapon for each limited via the battlepass. _The battlepass does not have one set of fixed weapons forever, like in Morimens or Hoyo games_. If you buy the BP, you get a weapon suitable for the character 100% of the time even if you decide not to pull on the weapon banner.  <:EndminYes:1319511272856883210>
the gameplay, outside of factorio, I am hearing is pretty mid

I like the combat a lot personally but I'm coming from a system I grew to hate with a burning passion (ZZZ). It is a little clunky in team building atm but it has been designed by someone who knows what they are doing for the long-term. No parry system, weak dodges, no i-frames on special moves. Every mistake in ZZZ just isn't in Endfield and I'm happy for it.

Exploration is fun, as you do it in two phases - you go exploring, then you come back with ziplines and power and route to what you want easy access to, and you use that time to double-check for things you missed
Anyway all I wanted to write was that I think HG have done something really different with the game from a design perspective and I think that's good news for the gacha genre
They have made a game that they want a lot of people playing at an even rate, consistently, each patch, that's what the gacha system is. It's designed to get people like me to play it every day.
